subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept openai/codex-action v1.11 in workflows that pass an OpenAI API key after a direct source-contract review, or should that update be split from the routine action bumps?
rationale: The decision accepts or rejects a changed third-party execution and secret-handling boundary; the repository policy requires direct Codex-source inspection before a verdict on this surface.

options.title: Audit then keep the bump
options.body: Review the exact Codex action implementation and release contract, then merge this grouped update only if the secret and execution behavior is acceptable.

options.title: Split the Codex revision
options.body: Land the ordinary pinned action updates separately and route the Codex action revision through a focused security review.

options.title: Keep the current Codex pin
options.body: Reject the Codex action portion if its reviewed contract is not acceptable for workflows that receive the API key.

recommendation.title: Audit then keep the bump
recommendation.body: Review the exact Codex action implementation and release contract, then merge this grouped update only if the secret and execution behavior is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: A workflow security owner is needed because the affected action executes with a repository secret.
